summary: VeiligWerk Beveiliging B.V. are ordering 27 CCTV and intruder alarm items for project De Wissel in Utrecht, for delivery on 27 November 2026.

order.payment_terms: Payment within 30 days of invoice date.

fulfilment.instructions: Deliver via the rear entrance and report to reception. Partial deliveries only by prior agreement. Email order confirmation to inkoop@veiligwerk.nl and quote IO-2026-0412 on the packing slip and invoice.

flags.message: Arrange delivery on 27 November via the rear entrance at Stationsplein 14 and ensure the driver reports to reception.
Obtain prior agreement before making partial deliveries against IO-2026-0412.
Email the order confirmation to inkoop@veiligwerk.nl and include IO-2026-0412 on the packing slip and invoice.
